WeSynced is all about keeping you close to your favorite person without any of the extra noise or pressure 🤍

One-Tap Emotion Sharing 📲: Just tap an emoji to share how you're feeling directly on your partner's home screen—no need to type out a full message.

Zero Pressure, Zero Stress 🍃: Forget read receipts or asking "Are you free to talk?" It's just a continuous, gentle connection between two people who care about each other.

Designed to be Calm 🎨: Soft pastel colors and smooth animations make the app feel like a warm hug rather than another notification fighting for your attention.

Complements Your Chat 💬: It doesn't replace your actual conversations; it just sits quietly in the background holding a simple "I'm thinking of you" until you're ready to catch up.

Thank you so much for trying out this very first version! 💌

Getting Started

1. Tap "Generate Random ID" to create your own pairing code, or type in one your partner already shared with you.
2. Tap "Connect" to start syncing.
3. Once connected, tap any emoji below to update your mood — your partner sees it instantly.

Staying Connected

Your mood stays visible to your partner even if you close the app. It only changes when you pick a new one, or tap "Disconnect."

The Widget

Add the WeSynced widget to your home screen to see your partner's mood at a glance, without ever opening the app.

Disconnecting

Tapping "Disconnect" lets your partner know you've intentionally stepped away — until then, your last mood stays exactly as you left it.

Reconnecting

Just enter the same pairing ID again anytime to pick up right where you left off.

Custom Moods

The four blank slots at the bottom of your mood picker are yours to define — tap one to set your own emoji and name it whatever you like. Long-press any custom slot anytime to change it.

A Couple of Small Steps, A Big Difference 💡

WeSynced relies on your phone quietly waking it up in the background so your partner's mood reaches you the moment they update it — even with the app fully closed. Most phones are designed to aggressively limit exactly that kind of background activity to save power, which is great for random apps you barely open, but it works against an app like this one whose entire purpose is staying quietly connected in the background. These two steps tell your phone to make an exception for WeSynced.

1. Turn Off Battery Optimization

By default, Android periodically freezes apps sitting in the background to save power. If WeSynced gets frozen, it can miss the tiny background "ping" that tells it your partner's mood changed — so you might open the app and find it out of date. Turning off battery optimization tells your phone to let WeSynced keep listening, and it barely costs any extra battery in return, since each update is instant and tiny.

2. Lock WeSynced in Recent Apps

On a lot of phones, swiping an app away from your Recent Apps screen doesn't just close it — it fully kills it and blocks it from waking back up in the background, even if battery optimization is already turned off. Locking WeSynced in your Recent Apps list (usually by long-pressing its card and tapping a lock icon) tells your phone not to do that, so it keeps quietly listening even after you've swiped through your other apps.

Taking both steps together is what makes your partner's mood actually show up instantly on your home screen widget, without you needing to keep the app open. If you skipped either one during setup, you can always turn it on later — your connection just gets a little more reliable once you do. 💜
